transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for that information. I also wanted to know when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. I'm also very sensitive to bright light after the surgery. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust. If it’s just mild and things look brighter than usual, wear sunglasses outside. But severe light sensitivity, or pain with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining that. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything for now. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent successfully conveyed all three content points in a single turn. `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` was covered by "A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust." `mild_case_advice` was covered by "If it’s just mild and things look brighter than usual, wear sunglasses outside." `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But severe light sensitivity, or pain with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need checking."
